summary: Established the SwiftPM project foundation with core models, thread-safe SQLite storage, SM-2 spaced repetition, a MarginNote 3 SQLite importer, a minimal SwiftUI app shell, and unit tests.
notes: The available execution host is Linux while this package targets macOS and imports CoreGraphics/SwiftUI, so swift test and swift build were not executed locally; the orchestrator should run the requested validation commands on macOS.
